description: The single resolution of the fgOS state root and lock root. The host resolves it once and exports FGOS_STATE_ROOT before exec of the Node payload; Node reads that variable and calls this route only when it is absent (the `node bin/fgos.mjs` compatibility channel), once, before any lock.

order.value: used verbatim; dispatch pins it into every child so a sandbox HOME does not move the root
<USERPROFILE>/.local/state/fgos; used only when HOME is unset

resolution.blank: a variable whose value is empty or only whitespace is treated as unset (trim before test); a non-blank value is used untrimmed
resolution.homeEmpty: HOME set to the empty string is set: the root is .local/state/fgos joined onto the empty string
resolution.formula: the same as resolve_machine_release_store_root in packages/distribution/rust/src/store.rs; the override meaning does not change
